tools.name: focus
tools.description: Spec Kit: make a task from tasks.md the current one before working on it. Returns its planned files and the requirements it serves.

tools.name: where
tools.description: Spec Kit: which tasks and requirements a file belongs to (planned, touched, linked, @spec anchors).

tools.name: status
tools.description: Spec Kit: where this project stands in the Spec Kit workflow (set up, constitution, active feature, plan, tasks, coverage, drift) and the command that comes next. Call it before suggesting a Spec Kit step.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Spec Kit autopilot: call this when, and only when, the work needs a decision only the person can make (the product idea, a [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] question, a conflict between their request and the spec, anything destructive or irreversible, credentials). It asks the person at once where it can and returns their answer; otherwise the autopilot waits for it. Never call it to ask whether to continue.

tools.name: pause
tools.description: Spec Kit autopilot: pause the run because the person said so in this conversation (stop, wait, I take over). Never to skip or end a step of your own accord. Stopping the autopilot altogether stays the person's command (/xref auto off).

tools.name: link
tools.description: Spec Kit: tie a file to a task (T###) or a requirement (FR-### / SC-###, optionally <feature>/FR-###), so an edit outside the planned files is no longer drift.
